exposure: Maternal CHIKV infection within 7 days before delivery
outcome: Severe maternal clinical presentation of CHIKV
cohort: The study participants were 246 pregnant women from French Guiana, divided into a group with Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection during pregnancy and a control group without CHIKV or fever.
finding: The study found no significant difference in pregnancy complications or severe maternal CHIKV clinical presentation between infected and uninfected pregnant women, but identified a potential excess risk of neonatal ICU admission when maternal infection occurred within 7 days before delivery.
